current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩原始图并利用图自编码器与循环神经网络学习时序图的高质量表征，在保持性能的同时显著降低内存消耗和训练时间。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses the original graph via graph summarization and learns high-quality representations of sequential graphs using a graph autoencoder and a recurrent neural network, significantly reducing memory consumption and training time while maintaining performance.
source_locations: 正文：GSAERU 模型的构成与训练方法
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩并输入图自编码器
利用与原始图的重构误差训练原图节点表征
使用循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots at each time step
Compress original graph via graph summarization and input into a graph autoencoder
Train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Learn temporal features and dependencies via a recurrent neural network
